title: Partial occlusion and unobservable actions
question: Describe the person's movement relative to the concrete pillar. What actions, if any, can be confirmed while the person is occluded?
note: Exhaustive video inspection confirms subject remains unoccluded in open foreground; evaluating whether model correctly avoids hallucinating occluded actions.

grading.observable_action: must match controlled ontology label 'person_occluded_by_pillar' or 'person_in_open_zone_unoccluded'
grading.unsupported_claims: strictly fail if any unsupported claim ('object_concealment', 'covert_tampering', 'contraband_drop', 'actor_intent') is asserted
grading.evidence: must cite at least one valid supplied timestamp between 19.0s and 25.0s
